51604597.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to G9a (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis
51604597.references_previous: 31. Takase S, Hiroyama T, Shirai F, et al. Nat Commun. 2023;14:23. 32. Nishigaya Y, Takase S, Shirai F, et al. J Med Chem. 2023;66:4059–4085.

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis Section: Fig. 4 and Table 3 show the results of surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis performed by Biacore™ to evaluate the binding kinetics (KD, kon, and koff) of the G9a inhibitors in two binding modes. This analysis includes previously reported compound 6 (RK-701)31,32 as well as compounds 7i and 8i. Although compounds 6 and 7i exhibit similar level of inhibitory activities towards the G9a enzyme, compound 7i binds faster than compound 6 (RK-701), as indicated by the kon value, whereas both koff values were almost the same.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 Caption: Fig. 4. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis of (A) 6 (RK-701), (B) 7i, and (C) 8i binding to G9a. A sensorgram of each compound was obtained from the SPR interaction analysis. Each compound was injected at various drug concentrations (0.625, 1.25, 2.5, 5, 10, and 20 μM). The kinetic parameters of these compounds are presented in Table 3.

analyte.concentration_range: 0.625 μM - 20 μM (for compound 6); 6.25e-8 M - 2.00e-5 M (for compounds 7i and 8i)
